title: Automated Planning
overview: Generate sequences of actions that achieve goals using symbolic descriptions of states and actions.
objectives: Describe actions with preconditions and effects

method.title: Action models
method.body: In STRIPS-style planning, actions have preconditions and add and delete effects over a set of facts.

method.title: Forward planning
method.body: Search forward from the initial state, applying any action whose preconditions hold in the current state.

method.title: Planning heuristics
method.body: Relaxed problems that ignore delete effects give informative estimates for guiding search.

method.title: PDDL
method.body: The Planning Domain Definition Language standardizes how domains and problems are written for planners.

pseudocode:
state = init
plan = []
while not goal <= state:
    a = choose(applicable(state))
    state = (state - a.delete) | a.add
    plan.append(a)
